notes.notes: [h3][b]Demo of purgatory's flower is out ![/b] [/h3][h3]and[/h3][h3] we are participating in the [b]June Steam Next Fest[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8974f9513ccb118a6b09994f3323b64bec334cd2.png"][/img][/p][h3]If you have time, please listen to the characters' stories for a moment.[/h3][h3]Purgatory flowers will be released in September.[/h3][p]This game deals with the miserable, tragic, and beautiful memories of two women, and the pain and healing that have occurred from them. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_Yws7WmKNG0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The amount of the demo is 1/5 of the total, and the playtime is about 30 minutes. Also, translation volunteering is always welcome![/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy the stories of prisoners struggling to escape from purgatory![/p]

notes.title: Turkish Translation Update!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that the Turkish translation has been completed and updated, thanks to the generous help of our volunteer, Zeynep Nazli Kolkiran.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114503/2dcf4360788034f27cdb017fb59afc6a9da980dd.png[/img]

We deeply appreciate her contribution and hope you have a wonderful experience with the game. 

As always, we welcome volunteer translators! If you're interested, feel free to contact us at panhwa1004@naver.com. 

Thank you!

notes.title: 'The Little UNI' Released!!
notes.notes:
[b]The game is a fangame for the Korean vocaloid "Uni," and the character and story shown in the game are not related to the official setting! [/b]

point-and-click adventure game in the form of a story with hand-drawn illustrations. Living on a small planet, Uni fights with ‘Rose’ and leaves in search of her own new planet. Go on an adventure to the planets with various characters and listen to their stories, and find a new planet for Uni to stay on.
